title: R4-B0 pre-registration: rules, thresholds, windows and scale method fixed BEFORE any Gate 1-4 run
baseline: R4-A2.2 sealed in Gate 0 (commit 4fa1a473d95362e7e7039bb88c407dc6c0b220a4), status DEVELOPMENT_VALIDATION
inputs: existing local predictions runs/r4a2/r4a22/{15023,15041}/{M1,M2} (hashes in experiments/R4B0/gate0/baseline_manifest_r4a2_2.json); no retraining, no new weights
change_policy: After this commit only crash / implementation-bug fixes are allowed, each documented in the gate report with the reason; no threshold, rule, window or method may change. Every gate runs once.
oracle_policy: Methods prefixed O_ read official labels (dist.npy or instance seeds) and are diagnostics only. They are never reported as model accuracy and never used as inference input for a claimed improvement.
matching_rule: A small instance is recovered iff some predicted region has IoU >= 0.5 with it (class-agnostic). Because instances are disjoint, a region can have IoU > 0.5 with at most one instance; the per-region credited count is computed and reported (regions_credited_to_more_than_one_instance must be 0). Best-overlap region = largest intersection.

gate1.width_primary: width_own_px = 2 * (max DIST_L2-mask-5 distance inside the padded instance mask - 0.5): inscribed edge-to-edge diameter of the instance's own mask
gate1.width_secondary: width_old_px = 2 * max(official dist to UNIT_BOUNDARY inside the instance) + 1 (R4-A2.2 definition, kept alongside, old report not overwritten)
gate1.other_bins_reported: lt3 and ge20 rows kept in the CSV, not part of the three-bin analysis
gate1.boundary_definition: instance boundary = official UNIT_BOUNDARY pixels inside the instance; prob_boundary_cov = share of them within 2 px of (prob > 0.5); region_boundary_cov = share within 2 px of the final region boundary
gate1.two_sided_rule: two sides are identifiable only if elongation = skeleton length / width_own >= 4, width_own < 20 px, and the two most frequent neighbouring instances across the instance boundary each hold >= 25% of its boundary pixels; then side1_cov / side2_cov are reported and both_sides_detected = min >= 0.8. Irregular units report only the overall coverage.
gate1.dist_rule: |max predicted distance inside the instance - max official distance inside the instance| > 2 px

labels.DIST_ERROR_*: dist_rule (only methods with a distance field)
labels.SEED_MISSING: no marker pixel inside the instance
labels.SEED_FUSED: marker pixels inside the instance but no marker with >= 80% of its pixels in this instance (seed shared with a neighbour)
labels.WATERSHED_ABSORBED: at least one own marker, but the regions grown from own markers cover < 50% of the instance
labels.OVER_SEG: >= 2 own markers, own regions cover >= 50%, but no single region covers >= 50%
labels.REGION_OVERGROWN: own regions cover >= 50% but the best region is > 2x the instance area and IoU < 0.5
labels.EVAL_LIMIT: not recovered, and the best region matches the instance core (instance minus its UNIT_BOUNDARY pixels) with IoU >= 0.5 and >= 90% of the region lies within the instance dilated by 2 px (pixel evidence, not width alone)
labels.NO_BOUNDARY_TRUTH: instance has no UNIT_BOUNDARY pixel inside the valid area

gate1.primary_rule: SUCCESS if recovered; EVAL_LIMIT if flagged; otherwise the earliest label in primary_failure_order; UNEXPLAINED if none
gate1.evidence_check: a separate script recomputes every label from the CSV evidence columns and must agree 100%

cases.rule: M2_hybrid failures, primary width bins 3-6 / 6-10 / 10-20 px, both sheets pooled; per bin the two most frequent primary_failure_stage values; per (bin, stage) 2 instances drawn with numpy default_rng(20261029) from the sorted (sheet, instance) list; if a group has < 2, the next stage fills

derived_distance.name: M1_DERIVED_DISTANCE
derived_distance.metric: cv2 DIST_L2 mask 3 to the binary map (prob > 0.5)

gate2.control: M2_PD_hybrid applies the same derived distance to M2's boundary probability, so M2_hybrid vs M2_PD_hybrid isolates the distance head within the same network
gate2.postprocess_interface: old_markers / hybrid_markers / segment from experiments/R4A/r4a2_1_seeds.py, unchanged
gate2.evaluation: experiments/R4A/r4a2_2_eval.py instance_metrics and boundary_metrics unchanged, same valid area; widths both definitions; runtime (post-processing seconds); topology: regions, regions < 50 px, over-segmentation

decision.m2_head_has_independent_value: M2_hybrid small recall - max(M1_DD_hybrid, M2_PD_hybrid) >= 0.02 on BOTH sheets
decision.m1_matches_or_exceeds: max(M1, M1_DD_hybrid) >= M2_hybrid - 0.01 on BOTH sheets -> prefer the simpler M1
decision.topology_guard: a method counts only if its small over-segmentation is <= M2_hybrid + 0.03 on both sheets

gate3.ideal_seed: one pixel per official instance (all instances) at the argmax of official dist inside it, first in raster order
gate3.split: for each primary width bin, among small instances NOT recovered by M2_hybrid: postprocess_fixable = recovered by O_M2D_ideal (same predicted field, ideal seeds); boundary_required = not recovered by O_M2D_ideal; of those, recovered by O_GTD_ideal = field-limited, not recovered by O_GTD_ideal = beyond watershed reconstruction / evaluation limit. Same split for M1_DD_hybrid with O_M1DD_ideal.
gate3.label: ORACLE - diagnostic upper bound, not a model result

gate4.input: runs/real/<work>/work.png map box (work.json map_box_work), exactly the images used in R4-A2.2

gsj_reference.probability: 15023 / 15041 R4-A2.2 M1 and M2 prob maps

line_width_estimator.line_components: 8-connected ink components with skeleton length >= 40 px and skeleton length / mean width >= 8 (removes text glyphs, dots, small symbols and filled patterns)
line_width_estimator.statistic: median over all accepted skeleton pixels
line_width_estimator.reliable_if: accepted skeleton px >= 2000, and among the 3x3 grid cells with >= 100 accepted skeleton px there are >= 5, with coefficient of variation of cell medians <= 0.25
line_width_estimator.estimator_validation: on 15023 rescaled by 0.5, 0.75 and 1.5 (INTER_AREA / INTER_CUBIC) the recovered factor w(rescaled)/w(original) must be within 15% of the true factor for all three; otherwise every China work is SCALE_UNCERTAIN

gate4.normalisation: factor f = w_gsj / w_work; applied once (INTER_AREA if f < 1, INTER_CUBIC if f > 1) iff the estimator is validated, the work is reliable and 0.5 <= f <= 2.0; else SCALE_UNCERTAIN and the original size is kept. No colour transform. Inference with unchanged M1/M2 best.pt and the R4-A2.2 post-processing; outputs resized back with nearest neighbour for overlay.
descriptive_stats: physical scale: source dpi metadata and work scale
RGB mean/std per channel, HSV saturation median
hillshade proxy: std of gray Gaussian blur sigma 8 px
pattern proxy: std of (gray - Gaussian blur sigma 2) on non-ink pixels
line density: accepted skeleton px per 1000 px^2
boundary probability: share p > 0.5 and p > 0.8, quantiles 50/90/99

predicted boundary composition at p > 0.5: share on ink (black-hat > 40 within 1 px), share on colour edges (Lab gradient magnitude, Sobel on median-blur-5 image, > 20) without ink, share on neither (texture / other)
gate4.window_rule: 256 x 256 px in work-image coordinates; per work 3 of the 9 cells of a 3x3 grid over the map box drawn with numpy default_rng(20261029), window centred on the cell centre and clipped to the map box. Fixed here before any Gate 4 output.
gate4.window_failure_types: per window the boundary composition above (ink / colour edge / other) for original and normalised input; local overlays for human review; no precision / recall / F1

allowed_recommendations: B: supervision target and sampling first
gate5.evidence_rule: A if, in the thin bins, most M2_hybrid failures are postprocess_fixable (Gate 3) and BOUNDARY_MISS is not the main primary stage; B if boundary_required dominates or BOUNDARY_MISS dominates; C if GSJ-internal results improved over M0 but China boundary statistics differ strongly from GSJ even after scale normalisation
